holding cost basis

  • CURIE: gmeow:holdingCostBasis
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/holdingCostBasis
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/finance

The cost basis of the holding — the original monetary amount paid to acquire the asset. Functional: a holding has one canonical cost basis (disputed values are standpoint-indexed claims).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Holding -> gmeow:MonetaryAmount; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:holdingCostBasis from gmeow:Holding to gmeow:MonetaryAmount when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Holding, gmeow:MonetaryAmount
